propositions: Over-trigger of full re-reviews due to undeclared file_impact causes 21% of re-reviews on byte-identical material; scoping the fail-safe to read-set and cited paths (ADR-0002 extension) reduces false positives.

Read-set recorded in signed manifest (normalized, deduplicated, repository-relative paths from observed fetch telemetry) must survive verification; modified read-set fails verification and invalidates.

When file_impact is empty, undeclared, and not poisoned, dependency hashing composes read-set with blast-radius glob patterns (rebar.toml, criteria/**, reviewers/**, workflow/gates/**), with membership digests tracking file addition/deletion under globs.
Three fail-safes (missing read-set, verification failure, basis resolution error) revert to invalidate-on-any-SHA-change; authenticated none-scope remains exempt from drift.
Attestation records currency-basis (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) in signed manifest and status output; ADR-0002 addendum documents the read-set field, composition rule, and membership digest.
Infrastructure lock contention prevented attestation minting for merged HEAD (69509d47fb) despite plan passing verification; re-run required to close ticket.
